title: Diver at Cosmic Pool
description: An overweight woman in a purple swimsuit and red swim cap sits on the edge of a high diving board, looking down into an indoor swimming pool. The pool water features a swirling cosmic vortex with a silhouetted diver at its glowing center, surrounded by colorful nebulae patterns under a purple-lit skylight.
prompt: An overweight middle-aged woman wearing a purple one-piece swimsuit and red swim cap sits on the edge of a weathered high diving board in an old indoor swimming pool facility, looking down into the water with a focused expression, her body positioned to dive, below her the pool water transforms into a swirling cosmic vortex with a silhouetted diver falling into a bright central light surrounded by colorful purple blue and green nebula-like patterns, Olympic rings visible on the tiled wall, purple light streaming from a glass skylight above, realistic yet surreal digital painting style
